name: Ontic
d:
At Ontic, you’ll join a team driven by collaboration, innovation, and a shared sense of purpose. We work together to solve complex challenges, support one another’s growth, and create a workplace where everyone feels welcome and empowered to do their best work. Our team brings diverse backgrounds and fresh perspectives, united by a passion for making the world a safer place and helping our clients succeed. If you’re looking to make an impact, keep learning, and be part of a supportive, mission-driven team—Ontic might be the place for you.

Ontic builds software that helps security professionals in both the private and public sectors protect people, places, and assets. Our platform unifies critical data, tools, and workflows so security teams can detect threats early, respond faster, and operate more effectively. We call this Connected Intelligence.

Ontic has achieved "in process" status within the Federal Risk and Authorization Management Program (FedRAMP) and is now listed on the FedRAMP Marketplace. This marks an important step forward in our commitment to bring modern, connected, and data-driven security operations to U.S. government agencies.

name: airtel
d:
Airtel was founded to provide global connectivity and unlock endless opportunities. Our organization embodies a unique blend of energy, innovation, creativity, dedication, scale, and ownership, all aimed at being limitless. At Airtel, we strive to go beyond our duties to create impactful solutions for our consumers. 
 
Our team is highly skilled and constantly growing, actively developing infrastructure to introduce cutting-edge technologies like 5G, IoT, IQ, and Airtel Black. We have successfully launched 5G services in over 5,000 cities and towns nationwide, with 10 million unique customers on the 5G network nationally. Airtel Black is another convenient consumer service that provides combined billing for family and friends under a single bill. We also offer enterprise solutions, including national and international long-distance services for carriers. With a subscriber base exceeding 574 million as of 2023, we are committed to delivering effective products that contribute to the realization of a 'Digital India', enabling millions of individuals to connect and thrive for a brighter future. 
 
Our presence spans 7,915 census and 802,577 non-census towns and villages, covering almost 96% of the country's population with 388,726 Rkms of optical fiber and an extensive distribution network of 1.2 million outlets. We've also implemented conservation initiatives that have saved 14,676 MWh of electricity, 4412 tonnes of paper through our e-bill initiatives, and recycled 3330 tonnes of e-waste. 
 
At Airtel, we believe in taking early ownership, delivering quality, and experimenting with various career paths to boost our trajectories and gain valuable insights into the business, making us the best in the industry. We are committed to creating the ultimate experience for our consumers while maintaining an ecological balance in the world.

d:
Euronics was founded in 2002 since then we have a single purpose of offering great innovative products & services. The idea was to capture the white space offered in the public washroom automation accessories segment by the fast-growing Indian IT and hospitality Sector. Today, we are the largest selling public washroom automation accessory brand in India.

Soon, in 2006, we expanded into industrial & entrance accessories. As part of our business strategy, we disrupted the entire supply chain and went directly to the consumers.
The rapid pace of industrialization and our focus on creating solid brand value with a direct supply chain strategy.

Furthermore In 2017; we launched Harrington Carpet Tile in collaboration with the Japanese company. We identified some critical challenges that the market is facing, and we decided to solve these problems with the help of inventory management & virtual reality technology.
Today, we are number amongst top Indian players in the space with a significant presence across the IT sector, hospitality, commercial building, airports, industries and retail space.

Now with over 30+ PAN India offices, 4 International offices & 500 + strong workforce, Euronics is a preferred brand to almost every fortune 500 company & leading Indian corporation.

We are working with a vision to grow this company with continuous product innovation, & the use of technology in all our processes.

name: TeamViewer
d:
TeamViewer provides a Digital Workplace platform that connects people with technology – enabling, improving and automating digital processes to make work work better.

In 2005, TeamViewer started with software to connect to computers from anywhere to eliminate travel and enhance productivity. It rapidly became the de facto standard for remote access and support and the preferred solution for hundreds of millions of users across the world to help others with IT issues. Today, more than 635,000 customers across industries rely on TeamViewer to optimize their digital workplaces - from small to medium sized businesses to the world’s largest enterprises - empowering both desk-based employees and frontline workers. Organizations use TeamViewer’s solutions to prevent and resolve disruptions with digital endpoints of any kind, securely manage complex IT and industrial device landscapes, and enhance processes with augmented reality powered workflows and assistance - leveraging AI and integrating seamlessly with leading tech partners. Against the backdrop of global digital transformation and challenges like shortage of skilled labor, hybrid working, accelerated data analysis and the rise of new technologies, TeamViewer’s solutions offer a clear value add by increasing productivity, reducing machine downtime, speeding up talent onboarding, and improving customer and employee satisfaction.
The company is headquartered in Göppingen, Germany, and employs around 1,900 people globally. In 2025, TeamViewer achieved a revenue of around EUR 768 million. TeamViewer SE (TMV) is listed at Frankfurt Stock Exchange and belongs to the MDAX. Further information can be found at www.teamviewer.com.

BeFiSc makes the invisible visible.

In today’s world, trust isn’t given; it’s verified.

The offering includes a variety of Indian and Western wear for men, women, and children. Over the years, jewelry, bags and footwear, home furnishings, furniture, gifts, organic food and personal care products have been introduced to the range.
 
An amalgamation of aesthetics and affordability, the brand is a celebration of India and its crafts, and is one of the country’s largest private platforms for products made from traditional techniques, skills and hand-based processes. Fabindia connects thousands of craft-based rural producers to urban markets, creating employment for artisan’s and preserving the country’s traditional handicrafts.

name: Hector Beverages
d:
Hello! We are Hector Beverages. With a ladleful of passion, tempered with honesty, an ounce of creativity & a generous sprinkle of excitement, we started off in 2009. 

We bring quality drinks, which quench thirst & make taste buds go ‘slurppp’. What we also promise with all our drinks is a magic power. Like Tzinga, our flagship energy drink that students and all-nighter urban animals swore by; Or Paper Boat, which brings a sunny smile and innocent memories, as you sip through these treasured recipes.

Any drink can be made to taste good. Or feel nutritious. But how many drinks tell a story? Because when companies get together and dole out a drink to the parched populace, it’s practicality. But when history and geography conspire to make a drink favoured through the ages, that’s destiny.

A culmination of efforts. Modified through trial and error. Perfected with every passing age. From a king’s royal cook to a soldier’s flask to a peace offering made by warring clans to a mother conjuring something special for her son’s return to a grand celebration of harvest. Everyone had something to contribute. And it’s their additions (and subtractions) that ultimately made their way into food carts in village fairs.

And while we’ve all experienced the joy of tasting these drinks at these carts at one point or the other, we’ve also experienced the often awful gastronomical aftermath of these little joys.

Our inspiration for Paper Boat lies in emulating these tastes and experiences standing tall on a benchmark of hygiene and safety. Getting the good moments out to you while avoiding the unpleasant bits.

So go on ahead, make new memories. We’ll watch your back.

Driven by 200+ builders and backed by Blume Ventures, Chiratae Ventures and Bertelsmann India Investments, we believe how we build matters as much as what we build. That research shaped AIRES's first cricket footwear range. As co-founder Zubin Samuel joined to lead brand identity and design, AIRES grew from a single cricket-shoe idea into two full divisions.

AIRES Performance engineers footwear from the ground up for Indian body types, playing surfaces, and climate — addressing a gap where over 70% of Indian cricketers play in shoes unsuited to their feet. It starts with cricket, where it engineers role-specific footwear for batsmen, bowlers, and all-rounders, and is built to expand across other sports as India's next generation of athletes rises. The division also runs athlete programs supporting professionals, promising young talent, and grassroots players facing economic barriers.

AIRES Lifestyle brings the same design rigor to everyday sneakers, aiming for the material quality and craftsmanship of established global design labels, made in India and priced for India rather than positioned as fast fashion.

Headquartered in Gurugram, Haryana, AIRES exists to build what should have existed long ago: performance and design engineered for how India actually plays, moves, and lives — not adapted from someone else's brief.

name: Prorata
d:
Prorata is India’s first fractional car ownership platform. 

Now, you can co-own your dream car by paying as minimum as 8.33% of the total cost of the car for your leisure and lifestyle purpose.

No! It’s a no loan, no EMI, no down payment & no rent policy. 

With 1 car, 12 tickets are sold and 1 ticket is 8.33% of the total cost of the car, and it gives you 30 days of usage per year for 5 years. 

After 5 years, the car is sold to the highest bidder and all the co-owners get the re-sale value back according to their percentage of ownership in the car. 

Based on your usage, you can buy up to 3 tickets for the car and it will give you more usage which is 60 days or 90 days. 

Accordingly, we form a group of 4-12 people in a locality (10-20km radius) interested in co-owning the same car. 

Afterward, all the co-owners use our app to reserve dates whenever they need the car and we provide doorstep pickup and drop service.

P.S.- This model doesn’t serve your daily commute needs. It’s only for your occasional and experiential usage.

Please download our app or visit our website to understand the entire model.

name: iLive Connect
d:

iLiveConnect is India's first continuous, clinically supervised, AI-enabled health monitoring ecosystem, built to shift healthcare from reactive treatment to proactive prevention. We combine medical-grade wearable devices, a real-time health-insight app, and a 24×7 Clinical Command Centre staffed by trained medical professionals, giving individuals, families, and organisations an always-on window into their health.

What We Do:
Most health monitoring happens once a year, at a clinic, after something has already gone wrong. iLiveConnect changes that. Our platform tracks vital parameters continuously- heart rate, ECG trends, SpO2, sleep, metabolism, calorie intake, and more- and flags meaningful changes before they become emergencies.

Who We Serve:
→ Individuals managing chronic conditions like diabetes, hypertension, and heart disease
→ Patients recovering at home after hospitalisation or surgery
→ Families of elderly parents- including NRI families, who need reassurance across distances
→ Corporates building serious employee wellness programmes
→ Anyone who believes prevention is better than cure

What Makes Us Different:
Technology alone is not enough. Every alert on our platform is reviewed by a real clinician. Our 24×7 Clinical Command Centre distinguishes meaningful changes from noise, and acts when it matters. 
We don't just collect physiological data. We interpret it clinically and act upon it.
Our Mission:
To shift India's perspective from treatment-first to prevention-first, one continuous heartbeat at a time.

Depuis 1976, nous avons une ambition : rendre le sport et ses bienfaits accessibles au plus grand nombre.

Aujourd’hui, 103 000 coéquipiers, présents dans plus de 80 territoires, partagent cette ambition au quotidien.

Entreprise mondiale, multisports et multispécialiste, nous imaginons des produits et des expériences pour tous les sportifs, de ceux qui débutent aux athlètes de haut niveau. Notre expertise et notre capacité à innover permettent à chacun de trouver le sport qui lui ressemble et de le pratiquer à sa manière.

Parce que pour nous, le sport ne se résume pas à la performance. Il crée du lien, donne confiance et contribue au bien-être de chacun. C’est cette conviction qui guide nos choix et la place que nous souhaitons prendre dans la société.

Elle nous conduit aussi à repenser nos produits : leur conception, leur durée de vie et les façons de prolonger leur usage. Réparation, seconde vie et autres modèles circulaires prennent ainsi une place croissante dans nos activités.

Et derrière Decathlon, il y a avant tout une culture et des valeurs communes : Vitalité, Générosité, Responsabilité et Authenticité.

Avec une conviction qui nous rassemble depuis toujours : le sport est à tout le monde. Chacun peut se l’approprier et le vivre à sa façon.

name: Social Bird
d:
Most brands are busy trying to be seen. We’re more interested in making sure they’re remembered. That’s been our thing at Social Bird from day one. We don’t just run campaigns, we build stories that feel natural, the kind people don’t skip, the kind that actually stay.

Started in 2020, Social Bird grew out of late-night ideas, random sparks of creativity, and a simple belief that marketing works best when it doesn’t feel like marketing. Today, that energy still runs the place. Our office is less “boardroom” and more “brainstorm over chai and maggi,” where the best ideas usually come mid-conversation, not from a presentation slide.

We work with creators across the spectrum, matching the right voices with the right brands so it never feels off. From influencer campaigns and meme marketing to PR, ORM, and digital, everything we do is rooted in how people actually behave online. If it doesn’t feel real, we don’t do it.

There’s always a bit of chaos, a lot of laughter and a team that genuinely enjoys the process. It feels less like work, more like building something together. And that shows in what we create.

For brands, we make sure you don’t just show up, you stand out without trying too hard. For creators, we open doors that actually lead somewhere.

If you’re looking for marketing that feels like a conversation, not a pitch, you’ll fit right in.

Every celebration is unique.
Every family carries a legacy.
Every couple has a story worth telling.

Our purpose is to translate those stories into work that feels timeless, personal, and deeply meaningful.

We are building Novella for those who believe that memories deserve intention.

For couples, it is an opportunity to be part of something created with care, thought, and uncompromising attention to detail.

For those who join our team, it is an opportunity to pursue craft at the highest level, to challenge conventions, and to contribute to work that will be remembered long after the celebration is over.

Our ambition extends far beyond weddings.

We aspire to become one of the most respected storytelling houses in the world — known not for the volume of stories we create, but for the depth with which we tell them.

Because in the end, people rarely remember every detail of a celebration.

They remember how it felt.

And that is what we exist to preserve.

As our logo says “Clicked at Sea ~ Delivered at Shore”, ShipsKart is an online marketplace where vessels, vessel owners, operators and managers can purchase marine products, consumables, equipments and service products required for the uninterrupted and efficient
operations of the vessels.

ShipsKart aims to deliver the following technology-driven outcomes to vessels, vessel owners, operators and managers:
o Sustainable and verifiable cost efficiencies
o 100% transparency
o Reviewed and curated quality
o Reduced lead times and assured delivery
o Real-time tracking of orders from placement to delivery

The problem that ShipsKart is targeting is the current status of the supply chain and procurement process in the industry.
Today, most maritime and offshore companies use antiquated and manual methods of receiving requisitions, managing them, seeking vendors, placing orders and arranging deliveries of spares, stores, consumables, provisions, etc., that are critical for the smooth and seamless operation of the thousands of vessels across the world. Even though these items account for 30-40% of total operating cost, very few companies (and these are the large ones) invest in making the system and process efficient, trackable and predictable.

name: Eggoz Nutrition
d:
At Eggoz we want to make a meaningful impact to improve the protein consumption of people by enriching the lives of the rural egg farmers. 

Rural egg farmers across the country, especially in northern states of India like MP, UP, Bihar where the temperature swings in extremes, have a major challenge in terms of keeping the production and quality intact with little or no access to modern technologies, good quality feed, veterinary advice and getting their eggs to a larger audience. Contaminated feeds or using feed like DDGS without any knowledge of their nutritive value can have an impact on egg production.  

Technology is an integral part of farm operations with Eggoz. Data and real-time monitoring play an important role in identifying deviations early and optimizing bird performance for profitable business, for farmers. Farmers are on-boarded to a streamlined program where they receive technical and veterinarian advisory support. We believe in 'Happy Hens, Healthier Eggs!' Eggoz purchases all the eggs produced with a guarantee and direct payments to their accounts. At Eggoz, we strive hard to onboard as many farmers as possible into egg farming and completely support them to grow their business. 

As far as the retail customers in the urban and semi-urban markets, the eggs that one consumed had only the date of packaging mentioned, with no clarity on when the eggs were laid. There is no mandatory requirement for these eggs to be packaged within a day or two or to be stored under proper storage conditions. 

The brand EGGOZ was born to solve the problem end to end to make sure the production of the egg farmers are packed, UV sanitized and brought to the retail stores within 1 day of laying, thereby completely preserving the nutritional value of the egg.

Every Eggoz egg you buy is your solidarity to the farmers of rural India and a promise to yourself to consume eggs that are free of any bad stuff.

name: VehicleCare
d:
Motor insurance claims in India suffer from unpredictable outcomes, inconsistent repairs, and poor customer experience.

VehicleCare is building a full-stack motor claims fulfillment platform that delivers predictable, transparent, and reliable claim outcomes by managing the repair ecosystem end-to-end.

We work with independent vehicle workshops to create a disciplined, accountable repair network—bringing standard pricing, SOPs, quality benchmarks, and SLA-driven execution.

In parallel, we partner with insurers and brokers to reduce claims leakage, improve turnaround time, and provide real-time visibility across the repair and settlement lifecycle.

This is an operations-first business, powered by technology—where execution, trust, and incentives matter as much as software.

Our focus areas:
• Managed & franchise workshop networks
• Motor claims operations & fulfillment
• Repair standardization & cost control
• Claims transparency & auditability
• Faster, fairer claims experience for customers

We believe fixing motor claims requires controlling outcomes—not just digitizing processes.

name: ENERGDIVE
d:
India's leading energy magazine, media, and insights platform covering power, renewable energy, oil & gas, hydrogen, energy storage, and sustainability.

India’s energy transition is one of the most complex transformations of our time — a fast-evolving system where policy, markets, technology, capital, and climate continuously reshape one another. As India advances toward net-zero and the vision of Viksit Bharat 2047, the national priority is no longer just expanding access, but elevating energy intelligence — moving from growth to green leadership, from capacity creation to systems optimisation, and from ambition to measurable, investible impact.

This moment demands more than reporting; it demands a knowledge movement that explains, interrogates, and connects the forces driving India’s transformation. A platform capable of mapping how fuels shape electrons, how markets shape capital, and how innovations reshape entire systems. This is the purpose of ENERGDIVE.

At the heart of this movement is the ENERGDIVE Magazine, India’s most premium energy leadership publication and the definitive voice of India’s energy transition. With deep analysis, design intelligence, and disciplined storytelling, it chronicles the reforms, technologies, and decisions defining India’s energy and climate future.

Complementing the magazine is the ENERGDIVE Portal, an AI-powered Strategic Intelligence Platform that delivers curated insights, data-rich narratives, and visual intelligence tools to help leaders process complexity faster and act with clarity.

Together, the publication and the portal form ENERGDIVE — a unified strategic intelligence & knowledge ecosystem that transforms information into intelligence, insight into influence, and influence into impact. ENERGDIVE exists to equip policymakers, corporates, investors, innovators, and institutions with the clarity and confidence needed to lead India from energy security to sustainability leadership.

SOFAR supports the transition to renewable energy through a comprehensive portfolio including PV inverters range from 1 kW to 350 kW, hybrid inverters range from 3 kW to 20 kW, battery storage system and smart energy management solutions for residential, commercial & industrial, and utility-scale applications. Founded in 2013, SOFAR has always insisted on independent innovation, established a global R&D network with three R&D centers and over 30% of its workforce assigned to R&D, thus gradually establishing the holistic technology and product R&D system. SOFAR has implemented a globalization strategy since its establishment and now has two global manufacturing bases with an annual production capacity of 10 GW PV & storage inverters & 1GWh batteries and an extensive service network of over 20 branch offices worldwide. SOFAR offices can now be found in the UK, Poland, Germany, South Korea, UAE, Pakistan, Australia, etc. By the end of 2021, SOFARSOLAR had shipped over 1 million inverters to more than 90 countries. As the world's fastest-growing solar energy brand, SOFAR stands firmly among the mainstream solar energy brands with a compound annual growth rate of 86% from 2019 till 2021. Due to the abilities in cutting-edge solar technologies, SOFAR has achieved China "CQC" certification, Chinese Top 5 String Inverter Brand, World's Top Suppliers of Energy Storage Solutions and and entitled by EuPD as TOP Brand PV Inverter in India, Poland, the U.K., Italy and Brazil. Looking forward, SOFAR will adhere to its mission of“Technology Drives Green Energy” to build its core competitiveness in independent innovation in Net-Zero era, expecting to accelerate the global clean energy transition, leveraging its leading solar and energy storage products and solutions.

Tax and Regulatory – including Corporate Tax, Income Tax, Expatriate Tax, Tax Litigation, and International Tax
